overview: Amdahl's law aur pipeline speedup: enhancement ka overall speedup.
coreConcept: Speedup = 1 / ((1 - f) + f/s), f = enhanced fraction, s = local speedup.
hinglishExplanation: Jitna hissa (f) improve hota hai, overall speedup usse limited rehta hai. Pipeline speedup = non-pipelined time / pipelined time. Parallel code fraction se cores ka speedup.
formalDefinition: Speedup = 1 / ((1 - f) + f/s), f = enhanced fraction, s = local speedup.
commonPitfalls: f ko time ke fraction ki jagah instruction fraction lena.
